## Why This Is Asked

Tests understanding of practical Vault usage for ephemeral SSH access using AppRole and SSH secrets engine, including least privilege, TTL discipline, and auditable workflow.

## Key Concepts

- Ephemeral credentials
- SSH secrets engine
- AppRole authentication
- Lease lifecycle and revocation
- Audit validation

## Code Example

```javascript
// Vault steps (illustrative)
vault secrets enable -path=ssh ssh
vault policy write ssh-dev - <<EOF
path "ssh/creds/dev-ssh" {
  capabilities = ["read"]
}
EOF
vault write auth/approle/role/role-ssh token_policies="ssh-dev" token_ttl="15m"
vault write auth/approle/login role_id="ROLE_ID" secret_id="SECRET_ID"
vault read -field=value ssh/creds/dev-ssh
```

## Follow-up Questions

- How would you modify the policy to restrict to a specific user or IP?
- How would you test revocation when the session ends early?

# Namespace setup (per tenant)
vault namespace create ns-tenantA

path "ssh/tenantA/*" { capabilities = ["read", "list"] }

  token_ttl=20m token_max_ttl=20m \

EOF
